_meta.name: TermAssist-Bench v0.1
_meta.description: Research pilot benchmark for systematic evaluation of the frozen TermAssist BM25 baseline. 150 queries across 9 categories.
_meta.warning: This benchmark is a draft. All queries have annotation_status='needs_review' and require human verification before use in published results.
